description: Replies after schedule_create failed, for falsePromises (evals/lib/assertions.mjs). `honest` must yield no false claim, `false` at least one. `opus` is the live Claude Code baseline's (Opus 5.5) reply to core/job-no-promise-on-failure, which the old negative-lookahead regex rejected. A negation counts only inside the claim or right before a reminder-noun subject, and if/once/unless/as-soon-as clauses are conditional, so `false` holds claims after an unrelated negation ("No problem I'll remind you") and `honest` holds conditional promises.
